| `userSearchPath` | string | Path used to search for users on the directory server. For example: ou=People,dc=lss,dc=dell,dc=com |
| `groupSearchPath` | string | Path used to search for groups on the directory server. For example: uid=name,ou=people,dc=domaincomponent or dc=domain component |
| `userIdAttribute` | string | Name of the LDAP attribute whose value indicates the user ID. Default value is uid. |
| `groupNameAttribute` | string | Name of the LDAP attribute whose value indicates the group name. Default value is cn. |

| `groupMemberAttribute` | string | Name of the LDAP attribute whose value contains the names of group members within a group. Default value is member. |
| `certificateFilePath` | string | Path to the server certificate file on the system.This is required for one way server authentication. |

## POST `/api/types/ldapServer/instances`

_4 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Request body** (required): `inline`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `authority` | string | Name of the LDAP authority to construct the LDAP server configuration. |
| `protocol` | `LDAPProtocolEnum` | Indicates whether the LDAP protocol uses SSL for secure network communication. SSL encrypts data over the network and provides message and server authentication. \|Name\|Value\|Description\|… |
| `autoDiscover` | boolean | Default is true if no server addresses are specified. When set as true, the LDAP server addresses are obtained using DNS lookup on the LDAP authority (requires DNS to be configured). |
| `serverAddresses` | array of string (IPv6 supported: true, Prefix-length supported: false, Port supported: false, DNS name supported: true) | List of IP addresses or FQDN hostnames of the LDAP server. If not specified, the address will be obtained using DNS lookup on the LDAP authority (requires DNS to be configured). |
| `port` | integer (unsigned int[16]) | Port number to connect to the LDAP server. Cannot be used when specifying a port via (deprecated) serverAddress. |
| `bindDN` | string | Distinguished Name (DN) of the user to be used when binding; that is, authenticating and setting up the connection to the LDAP Server. For example: Administrator@mycompany.com or… |
| `bindPassword` | string | Password to use when binding a new LDAP session. |
| `userSearchPath` | string | Path used to search for users on the directory server. For example: ou=People,dc=lss,dc=dell,dc=com |
| `groupSearchPath` | string | Path used to search for groups on the directory server. For example: uid=name,ou=people,dc=domaincomponent or dc=domain component |
| `userIdAttribute` | string | Name of the LDAP attribute whose value indicates the user ID. Default value is sAmAccountName. |
| `groupNameAttribute` | string | Name of the LDAP attribute whose value indicates the group name. Default value is cn. |
| `userObjectClass` | string | LDAP object class for users. Default value is user . In Active Directory, groups and users are stored in the same directory path, and are in a class called group. |
| `groupObjectClass` | string | LDAP object class for groups. Default value is group. In Active Directory, groups and users are stored in the same directory path, and are in a class called group. |
| `groupMemberAttribute` | string | Name of the LDAP attribute whose value contains the names of group members within a group. Default value is member. |
| `certificateFilePath` | string | Path to the server certificate file on the system . This is required for one way server authentication. This argument is required if the value of the protocol argument is ldaps. |
| `timeout` | integer (unsigned int[32(msec)]) | Timeout for establishing a connection to an LDAP server. If the system does not receive a reply from the LDAP server after the specified timeout, it stops sending requests. Default value 30000 (30 seconds). |
